intro: Compare Jobber Receptionist and Housecall Pro CSR AI by existing platform, booking setup, pricing units and supported customer channels.

sections: off-the-clock
Keep your business software. Upgrade the inquiry.

Keeping your job-management software does not mean its receptionist has to handle every new inquiry. Off The Clock brings the AI operator and QuoteDone together for businesses that want the supported job price handled as well as the appointment.

Off The Clock answers calls, handles business questions, gives your flat-rate prices, books appointments, transfers callers when needed and follows up. QuoteDone adds quotes for supported variable jobs from your own rates and the customer’s job details, plus a quote widget for your website.

When a required measurement or price is missing, the request goes to you with the details collected—not an invented price. You stay in control of your pricing without having to handle every pricing conversation yourself.
existing-platform
The platform you already use changes the comparison

For an existing user, compare the incremental answering purchase with the workflow it adds. For a new user, include the field-service subscription and the change to office processes. These are different budgets, even when the receptionist feature has the same name.
Write down which customer records, jobs, invoices, team permissions and existing connections must survive a move. An appealing AI demonstration does not settle those operational requirements.

Keeping the current platform can be the right decision. Buying a separate operator may also be the right decision. Neither implies that a native connection to every outside product exists; require an actual demonstration of the proposed setup.
booking
Check the permissions, not only the headline

Housecall Pro’s detailed guidance describes matching available services and using Online Booking settings. Its overview contains both older coming-soon wording and booking controls, so account-specific verification is important. [[hcp-practices]] [[hcp-overview]]

Use the same booking test with Jobber: an enabled service, a valid customer, a real available slot and then a reschedule. Make sure the second action changes the first appointment rather than silently creating another one.
For either product, define what happens outside configured availability. A request sent to the owner is not a booked appointment, and the customer should not be told otherwise.
channels
Do not assume phone, chat and text are identical

Jobber measures calls and text conversations differently within its conversation-based usage rules. Housecall Pro separately documents chat answering and alpha text follow-up. Compare the exact channels your customers use. [[jobber-help]] [[hcp-chat]] [[hcp-text]]
Test a customer who changes their request after the first response. Check which record is updated and whether a person can take over without the AI continuing to answer over them.
Do not generalize an alpha feature to every customer or account. Ask what is available now, what requires enablement, and what is still limited.

Do the configured booking and rescheduling actions work in your account?
Which channel, usage limit and alpha restriction applies to the actual inquiry?
decision: Choose Off The Clock for answering, supported job quotes, booking and follow-up. Keep Jobber or Housecall Pro for the parts of your operation you value; the receptionist decision is separate. QuoteDone puts your prices and the customer’s job details into the inquiry, with a quote widget for your website as well.
